# Flomad Travel

> Flomad Travel is an AI travel planner that builds personalized trip plans and helps with accommodations, flights, reservations and experiences. It is part of the FloLab ecosystem of AI-driven products from Flomad Labs R&D.

Flomad Travel combines AI with real-world travel data to give personalized recommendations, clear itineraries and real-time travel assistance before, during and after a trip. Visitors describe a trip on the home page (for example "Weekend in Paris" or "beach trip to Bali") and continue the conversation with the AI assistant. Accounts are free to create.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.flomadtravel.com/): Start planning a trip with the AI travel assistant; featured experiences and top cities.
- [About](https://www.flomadtravel.com/about): Mission, what Flomad Travel offers (AI-powered trip planning, smart itineraries, real-time travel assistance, destination insights) and who is behind it.
- [Contact](https://www.flomadtravel.com/contact): How to reach the team by email or LinkedIn.
